notes.title: Update 0.6: Stuff for Cats
notes.notes:
🔺Important: 
Due to the large content update, the game's price has increased to $2. Thank you for your support!


✨ New Content:
1. Cat Items:

Litter Box — the cat will now use it for bathroom needs.

Scratching Post — the cat will only leave scratches near it.

Toy and Ball — the cat can play with them to increase activity and fun.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/1e878c4cf61f8ea6d4b1d62669605a0f83cdb96f.gif"]

2. Cat Bowl and New Food Types:
You can now place food into the bowl. Three food types:

Regular Food — restores 100% hunger.

Milk — restores 50% hunger and triggers zoomies behavior.

Fish — restores hunger and increases love.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/7cad8d21f825e36b432ce5df7821f37c4da4b11a.gif"]

3. Jumping Animation:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349120/e422de9465d4316013dc77c433c9f3414ce116c5.gif"]
New jump animation added for the cat.

⚠️ Custom cat skins need to be updated and reuploaded to the Workshop to support it.

4. "Walk on Border" Mode:
The cat can now walk up, down, and even on the ceiling of the screen.

5. Zoomies Behavior:
Added a new behavior pattern for zoomies — the cat will energetically run around the screen.

6. UI & Game Scaling:
You can now adjust the size of the UI and in-game elements in the settings.


🐛 Fixes & Improvements:
Reduced the volume of scratching sounds.

The cat now sleeps shorter when falling asleep on its own.

Fixed missing animation segments.

Removed the "Eating" sound type from the sound settings.

Updated several Chinese translations.

notes.title: 0.3.7 Update
notes.notes:
List of changes:

- Achievement the Star 150 is working.
- The Cat can to create a poop.
- Cleaning up poop brings a star.
- The Cat meows when hungry.
- Duration of the adventure - 15 minutes (Previously it was 30 min).
- The Cat can to hunting on your Mouse time to time.
- FIX: The setting of volume can be set to zero.

notes.title: 0.3.6 Small changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug: Star does not disappear completely.
- Fixed bug: Feeding brings Star.
- Fixed bug: Cat move after sleeping in bed.
- You can to change frame rate in the settings menu.
- You can to change cat volume in the settings menu.
- You can to change UI volume in the settings menu.
- Tray: Hide/Show game.
- Do not allow moving cat/bed by dragging outside the screen.
